Release - [2026/10/28] Thanks to the ms-swift community for supporting training of Unlimited OCR 2. - [2026/10/27] 📊 We release MarathonDocBench, a new benchmark for ultra-long document parsing. - [2026/10/27] 🤝 Thanks to the ModelScope community for their support.

## Ficha rápida

- baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2
- 3.3B parámetros
- VRAM mínima estimada 2.6 GB (Portátil / GPU 4 GB)
- ~317 tok/s en RTX 4090 (Q4)
- licencia mit
- 493 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

Pioneering the OCR-3.0 Era: From Long- to Unlimited-Horizon Parsing.

Release - [2026/10/28] Thanks to the ms-swift community for supporting training of Unlimited OCR 2. - [2026/10/27] 📊 We release MarathonDocBench, a new benchmark for ultra-long document parsing. - [2026/10/27] 🤝 Thanks to the ModelScope community for their support. Our model is now available at ModelScope. - [2026/10/27] 🤝 Thanks to the Baidu Cloud team for their support. Our model is now available on Baidu Cloud. - [2026/10/27] 🤝 Thanks to AK for creating a new demo for us. Try it at Unlimited-OCR-2.

What's New in 2 Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA): Compresses text-visual attention interactions from ultra-long sequences down to a fixed-size set of working references (e.g., 512 tokens). This bounds computational complexity, keeping per-step decoding latency and memory footprint nearly constant regardless of document length. From Long- to Unlimited-Horizon Parsing: Powered by SR-SWA, Unlimited-OCR 2 achieves true, unbounded document parsing within a finite context window—effectively eliminating quadratic attention scaling and memory bottlenecks as documents grow.

Unlimited OCR 2 supports Transformers (native, for quick tests) and SGLang (recommended for serving).
